name: Endoskeleton armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts helmet, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR (pivots at neck base, sternum, between shoulder blades, shoulder joints, elbows; forearm along -Y). Joints eye, piston, plasma, damage 0...1; followers eyeGlow, pistonL, pistonR, plasmaCell, exposed switch option at 0.05.
parts: chrome skull helmet with deep eye sockets, brow ridge, nasal cavity, jaw bar, teeth and crest
ribcage of curved chrome ribs on a vertebral spine with sternum bar
chest plasma cell housing with glass core and cyan plasma
ball shoulders with plate and humerus bone
double-bone forearms with hydraulic cylinder, extendable piston rod and skeletal hand
exposed wiring and spark prongs on the chest
back brace plate with hydraulic hoses
style: Terminator-style polished chrome skeletal exo-armour, mirror finish with dark gunmetal joints, red eyes and cyan plasma.
summary: Endoskeleton chrome exo-armour kit: skull helmet with red eye sockets, ribcage chest with plasma cell, hydraulic forearm pistons, skeletal hands and ball shoulders.
